xfails.expectedDiagnostic: code.lua Lua 5.1.5 compiler parity gap: expected - LOADBOOL *%d; actual 2 - TEST 2
xfails.responsibleModule: compiler repeat-condition constant lowering and Lua 5.1.5 bytecode parity
xfails.reason: The generic lua5.1-tests archive has three opcode expectations that do not match released Lua 5.1.5; those are corrected in memory from a SHA-locked luac oracle while the upstream file stays byte-for-byte unchanged. After those corrections, the first project-only gap is repeat-until-nil lowering: Lua 5.1.5 emits LOADNIL/LOADBOOL/TEST/JMP/RETURN, while this compiler omits LOADBOOL and begins the condition with TEST.
